text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D21","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 8 H7 THRU` "},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"IZBP"}],"comment":"Dimension D21 specifies an ⌀8 H7 fit hole on a part that receives IZBP plating, but the drawing does not state whether the H7 tolerance accounts for the plating thickness. The plating buildup will reduce the bore size and can cause the mating pin to no longer fit; the designer must either open the pre-plate machining tolerance to allow for coating thickness or add a note permitting reaming after plating.","recommended_correction":"Adjust the pre-plate hole tolerance to compensate for the IZBP coating thickness, or add a note specifying reaming to H7 after plating."}]}
